en.html: Kageaki(If I am a warrior...)

Would a proper warrior neglect his equipment?

No. Careful maintenance, always. That was what one ought to do.

Always on the battlefield. An enemy might appear at any time. Once attacked, stamping one's feet over the rust one had left on the sword was not a useful form of defense.

Until now I had never even thought of this.

...Still. Surely this was how it ought to be.
